days.title: Brunch, botanical garden, lava cave
days.planNote: Dry until about 13:00, heavy rain 13–16, light showers after.

items.name: Mercado da Graça (quick fruit stop)
items.note: On foot from base. Bananas, fruit.

items.name: Brunch at Jardim Natural Food & Coffee
items.note: GF-friendly, opens 10:00. Ask: sem glúten e sem soja.

items.name: Jardim Botânico António Borges
items.note: Before the rain.

items.name: Continente Modelo: GF snacks for the hike

parking.name: Supermarket car park
parking.note: Fajã de Baixo branch; there is a second Continente Modelo in Arrifes.

items.note: Drive from base. 'Sem Glúten' shelf, water.

items.name: Gruta do Carvão: short lava tube tour
items.note: Arrive 14:15, QR ticket. Guided only.

items.name: Dinner: O Churrasco or O Baco (GF)
items.note: No marinade, salt and garlic only. Pack Friday's bag. Pin shows O Churrasco; O Baco is 800 m west.

days.title: Ocean hot spring, Sete Cidades rim hike, sunset
days.planNote: Dry, fair to clear all day. Low tide 09:28, high tide 15:31. Sunset about 17:35.

items.name: Ponta da Ferraria ocean hot spring

parking.name: Car park at road end (Termas da Ferraria)
parking.note: Steep switchback road down; use low gear.

items.note: Leave base 08:00. Best within 2 h of low tide. Hold the ropes.

items.name: Miradouro da Boca do Inferno

parking.name: End of paved road (Canário forest road)

items.note: View over all crater lakes.

items.name: Hike PR03 SMI Vista do Rei → Sete Cidades

parking.name: Miradouro da Vista do Rei
parking.note: Leave the car here; taxi back after lunch.

items.note: 7.5 km, about 2 h, easy, one way along the crater rim, then forest down to the village. Ends at Igreja de São Nicolau. Taxi back to the car.

items.name: Lunch in Sete Cidades, lake bridge, taxi to car
Sunset at Miradouro da Ponta do Escalvado
items.note: Then 35 min back to base.

days.title: Hot waterfall, mud massage, move to Furnas
days.planNote: 45% rain; rough sea (whale trip moved away from today).

items.name: Miradouro da Lagoa do Fogo (only if not in cloud)
items.note: Check the webcam first; skip if in cloud.

items.name: Caldeira Velha warm waterfall pool
items.note: Book the full ticket online (€10); the date cannot be changed after paying. November hours 09:00–17:30.

items.name: Lunch in Ribeira Grande
items.note: Ask about gluten and soy.

items.name: Volcanic mud massage at Termas das Caldeiras
items.note: Book by phone or at the desk. Full body, firm pressure, includes private thermal pool.

items.name: Arrive base Furnas
items.note: About 40 min drive. Quiet evening.

items.name: Caldeiras das Furnas (fumaroles in the village)
Fumarolas da Lagoa das Furnas: cozido pits
items.note: Pots come out about 12:00–13:00.

items.name: Lunch in Furnas
items.note: Cozido often has blood sausage or chouriço; ask about gluten.

items.name: Parque Terra Nostra thermal pool and garden

parking.name: Largo Marquês da Praia parking
parking.note: Same square as lunch; leave the car.

items.note: Closes about 17:00. Dark swimwear.

items.name: Poça da Dona Beija

parking.name: Poça da Dona Beija car park (small)

items.note: 19:00–20:30, QR ticket. Dark swimsuit, €2 locker.

days.title: Salto do Prego and the wild northeast
days.baseNote: Night to be decided, Furnas preferred

items.name: Hike PRC09 SMI Sanguinho / Salto do Prego

parking.name: Faial da Terra village (near bus stop)

items.note: 4.6 km medium loop, about 2 h: forest trail, waterfall, hamlet. Open.

items.name: Lunch in Nordeste and Miradouro Vista dos Barcos

parking.name: Nordeste centre, Rua da Nazaré
parking.note: Vista dos Barcos viewpoint is a lay-by 600 m south on the main road.

parking.name: Lay-by on the EN 1-1ª, Achadinha
parking.note: Nearest mapped parking. You may be able to park closer.

items.name: Chá Gorreana tea plantation
items.note: Free tasting.

items.name: Night: to be decided (Furnas preferred, close to Vila Franca for Tuesday's 08:30 boat)

days.title: Whale watching, Lagoa do Fogo, back to Ponta Delgada
days.planNote: About 40% rain; swell high in the models. The operator decides on the day.

items.name: Check out, luggage in car
items.note: About 20 min to Vila Franca.

items.name: Whale watching: Terra Azul Zodiac (arrive 08:15)

parking.name: Free street parking at Vila Franca do Campo marina
parking.note: Yellow boats mark the Terra Azul base.

items.note: Moved from Saturday by the operator; the original voucher stays valid. The operator may decide on the spot at 08:30. Rain gear, warm layer, snacks.

items.name: Lagoa do Fogo: walk down to the lake (if clear)

parking.name: Miradouro da Lagoa do Fogo lay-by

items.note: About 4 km and 75 min, steep, out and back. Skip if in cloud.

items.name: Fill up the car: Gasolina 95 (green nozzle)

parking.name: Fuel station on Avenida Príncipe de Mónaco

items.name: Return the rental car at Ponta Delgada airport

parking.name: P3 Rent-a-car, Aeroporto João Paulo II

items.note: Full tank, film the car, keep the receipt. By 08:30.
